title: Billing
intro: Your plan, usage and invoices. ImpactOS never deletes your data for late payment.
unbilled: {amount} will be added to your next invoice (upgrades, extra usage).
dataPromise: Invoices are payable from domestic (non-FC) funds. Read-only mode lets you view, export and pay, but not change records.

usage.title: Usage
usage.note: When a limit is reached, adding more is paused; nothing you already have is affected. Field staff with only the self-service role are free.

plan.title: Plan
plan.trialing: Free trial of {plan}: {days} days left. Choose the plan to continue with after the trial.
plan.pending: Changes to {plan} at the start of the next billing period.
plan.rules: Upgrades apply now; the rest of this period is charged pro rata on your next invoice. Downgrades apply from the next period. Prices are before GST.
plan.failed: Could not change the plan. Try again.
plan.downgradeBlocked: Your current usage is above that plan's limits ({limits}). Reduce it first.

applied.trial: Saved. Your first invoice will use this plan.
applied.now: Upgraded. The difference for this period will be on your next invoice.
applied.nextPeriod: Saved. The change starts with your next billing period.

pay.title: Pay {number}: {amount}
pay.intro: Scan the QR with any UPI app, or transfer to the bank account. Then enter the UTR (transaction reference) so we can confirm it.
pay.submitted: Thank you. We will confirm the payment within one working day.

errors.utrInvalid: Check the UTR: 6–40 letters and numbers.
errors.utrUsed: This UTR has already been reported.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.notFound: This invoice is no longer open.

support.title: Support access
support.intro: Let the ImpactOS team look at your records to fix a problem. Access is read-only, ends automatically, and every page they open is listed below.
support.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Import fails on Hindi names

errors.reasonShort: Describe the problem in a few words.
errors.forbidden: Only the Secretary can give access.

help.title: Ask ImpactOS support
help.intro: Tell us what went wrong. We reply by notification, usually within one working day.
help.subject: Subject
help.bodyPlaceholder: What were you trying to do, and what did you see?
help.privacy: Do not include Aadhaar, bank or medical details. If we need to look at your records, your Secretary can give us temporary access.
help.check: Add a subject and a short description.

banners.readOnly: Your workspace is read-only because an invoice is unpaid. You can still view, export and pay.
banners.pastDue: An invoice is overdue. Please pay to avoid read-only mode.
banners.trial: Your free trial ends in {days, plural, =0 {less than a day} one {# day} other {# days}}.
banners.support: ImpactOS support can view your records until {until}.
